title: Shared observability record definitions
description: Join keys align with the Hermes Forge usage record (draft schema_version bee.usage/v1). This file does not define that usage record. Final usage field names come with the Hermes Forge freeze notice. Missing numeric usage is not represented here; consumers of the usage record must treat missing values as null with an unknown or partial status, never as zero.

utc_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 form with second precision.

id_token.description: Opaque identifier. Not a URL, path, hostname, or secret.

scrubbed_text.description: Free text that has already been scrubbed. Must not contain secrets, keys, tokens, environment-file contents, patches, prompts, private URLs, or hostnames.

join_keys.description: Keys used to join to the Hermes Forge usage record (draft schema_version bee.usage/v1). All five may be null on snapshots that are not about a single attempt.

provider_label.description: Extension identifier for an open vocabulary (agent source kinds, routes, resource kinds, providers). Lower-case token: not a URL, path, hostname, or secret. Known values are listed next to each field; other providers (for example openrouter) are valid extension labels.

record_type.description: Common envelope discriminator: <record name>/v<major>. These records carry it in `schema`; the frozen Hermes Forge usage record carries it in `schema_version` (bee.usage/v1). See observability/envelope.py.
